basic_info.description: A jewel atop Telegraph Hill!! Rarely available, this absolutely gorgeous tri-level SINGLE FAMILY HOME has been meticulously renovated and maintained.  Sun bathe from your own private patio and roof deck. You'll bask in the beauty of iconic Coit Tower, while experiencing jaw-dropping views of the Golden Gate Bridge, as well as enjoying city site lines down Union.  LUXURY AT EVERY LEVEL!!  The Top level bursts with sunlight, featuring two wonderful rooms, great for bedrooms, home offices, or guest suites.   The main level hosts the fabulous open kitchen-living-dining room layout boasts Liebherr built-in refrigerator, Wolf range, Bosch dishwasher and microwave. It also features a primary suite, complete with a double sized vaulted skylight, multiple closets, and glamorous en-suite updated bathroom.  The lower level has interior access from the spacious tandem 2 car garage, a cozy bonus room: ideal for a home gym, or movie/game room, and a bonus wine/storage room.  Ideal location, walking distance to iconic restaurants and shops, right in the center of everything you could want!  CALL THE MOVERS, YOU'RE READY TO GO!!
